title: Outstanding Room - Incredible Value
text: The hotel and staff are incredible, the room exceeded all of my expectations - this is what i would expect from something twice the rate i am paying - my only frustration has been the rudeness of other guests, parents letting their children run up and down the hallways screaming etc, you may want to bring earplugs.

title: my opinion
text: Huttons hotel, i read the reviews and was scared , but my expreiance was different we booked a triple room it was on the ground floor,three single beds i speciffically askd for 3 adult beds as i didnt want to end up in a small bed for childern only , not enough power plugs for 3 ppl wanting to charge phones. complmentary tea and coffee

title: Good Hotel and Location
text: The Cons: 1- I called the hotel 2 times on two different occasions to confirm our arrival and make some request. The hotel failed to notify me, even though I am a Hilton Honors member with gold status, either on the two occasions I called the hotel, or by email or text, that this area of the city will host a bicycle race and that all limousine and taxi access to the hotel will not be possible. As a result, myself and my family had to be dropped at a subway station with 5 pieces of large luggage to take the subway to a station near the hotel. We had to carry our luggage up and down the stations and walk the streets to the hotel. This is really unacceptable and the hotel should have informed their arriving guests of this event and offer them options. 2- The Junior suite we stayed in was very small in comparison to other junior suites in other properties I previously stayed in when in London. 3- On our first night, a trailer was dropping merchandise on the street our room is overlooking. The driver kept the engine on and it was extremely loud and we were unable to sleep. I called the front desk and they acknowledged the issue and said that they cannot do anything about it and it will take some time. Pros

title: Great location and Great value
text: I stayed here recently for an overnight, between business and personal commitments. This comes up fairly often, so I have tried out hostels, pod rooms, airbnbs, several hotels, before finding Pasha. I found this to be the best value/quality/location/price combo for me. The room was clean, comfortable and warm. It had tea and coffee facilities and a large bathroom. It was quiet. The staff were friendly and offered to help me with bags. There's a busy bus route a 2 minute walk away, making it cheap and easy to get around London. For the first time in months, I have booked the same place back-to-back stays because I think I've finally found a hotel that is cheap, without being dirty/sketchy/having terrible facilities or suchlike!

title: Solid budget option - easy access to centre
text: For the price this is a decent option. Short walk to dlr which takes you into town centre very quickly. Also shops near the dlr including a Tesco, a decent Turkish restaurant and a craft beer pub. Room was actually quite quiet despite being on the busiest road in London. Only criticism I have is the service at reception/bar was very slow in the evenings. Watching the older European lady use the reception computer reminded me of watching my grandma use a computer for the first time. Painful!

title: Excellent
text: Being a regular for years after knowing one or two really awful hotels in london. This one is clean, friendly staff and even if prices can seems high, it is worthwile if you compare it to other 3 stars hotels in london..

title: AGAIN AND AGAIN
text: I was over in London for a weekend and decided to stay in this hotel as a result of a previous experience. Firstly hats off to the staff. As a H Gold member i was up graded to an executive room with access to the lounge. I see now why the bar closes at 21.00 it is a very different type of customer as the girls in the lounge had to put with dogs abuse on two of the nights that I was there. For some of the staff English was their 2nd language yet they must have known that they were been slagged off. yet they were very professional. I can't recommend this hotel strongly enough, very close to city airport yet only 25 mins to westminter station

title: They helped me out of a pickle!
text: I stay in London every week in business and had booked a Wednesday evening at a different Ibis. That Wednesday evening my schedule suddenly changed and I had to find a room for the following evening and selected this hotel. I quickly booked online and the next day, packed up my bag and moved hotels. I arrived to discover that I had made a huge error. In my haste, I had booked for the same day as my other hotel. This meant I didn’t have a room for the night and I had been charged in full as a ‘no show’ for the night before. I stood there in despair! I had no time to try and find anywhere else but I had nowhere to stay. Within minutes the helpful team at the hotel transferred my incorrect booking to the correct night which meant I now had somewhere to stay. They strictly didn’t need to as it was my error. They did it to help me out. Thank you for being so flexible. Many other hotels wouldn’t be.

title: Lunch with friends
text: Casual lunch with friends. Food acceptable although bit on the pricey side for what it is. A quarter of rotisserie chicken including two sides around the £13 mark and the chicken was dry. Very welcoming, pleasant staff although I object to the practice of adding a £1 charitable donation on my behalf to the establishments charity of choice. If the Ship inn wish to give to charity they can do it from their profit, I prefer to chose when donating rather than it being done/ added to my bill without even asking. To clarify I do give to charity but when I chose to not when I’m eating out.

title: Incredibly overpriced & far from a luxury or 5 star hotel!
text: I never write reviews but I felt incredibly ripped off by this hotel and wanted to warn others. The street its on is adorable, the lobby was nice enough, and the few staff members were well-meaning, but not well trained. Payment for the room was required in advance upon check-in

title: One night with our three grand children.
text: Very dated and in need of decoration. Over priced for what we paid. Not a nice experience for our grand children!!!!! Only good thing about it was its location. The whole hotel needed up dating and renovation as it was extremely run down. I would give it no stars if that was possible.

title: Disappointing
text: On the plus side, the room (large studio?) was spotlessly clean

title: Great price in a pricey town!
text: Small room & bathroom. friendly knowledgable staff. Great location near "22 bus" & Victoria station. The beds were a bit springy, but you get what you pay for. Breakfast was fantastic!!!

title: Dissapointing
text: The hotel is in a good location on a quiet street in Earls Court near the tube station and many options for meals. Half of the staff is very friendly (Mohamed at the front desk in particular was extremely helpful), and half I would say grumpy, especially the guy who was at the desk Sunday morning before 7 AM. There is no air conditioning so you need to leave your windows open but there are no window screens. The bathrooms are really small, about the same as a cruise ship. There is one small elevator that seemed to be enough. Breakfast was about what I expected for continental, but it never changed. The breakfast attendants were very efficient and after breakfast they doubled as room attendants. The rooms offer no dresser or chest of drawers to unpack in so you are basically working out of your suitcase.

title: Awful service
text: The location is nice but that is about all that the hotel has to offer. The breakfast that is included consists of small boxes of cereal milk and coffee. While we were there we had to place a call to the airport. At the lobby we were greeted by a young man who said thwy did not extend that courtesy to their guests to go use a payphone. The iron they loaned us did not work. We have stayed in london before and loved it. Definitely would never stay here again and DO NOT RECOMMEND!

title: Smallest room I've ever seen
text: Excellent location and clean enough but rooms extremely small and size of beds in a doubleroom way too small for two adults!!!

title: Nice except the noise isolation
text: Impossible to sleep I could hear the neighboµr the next rented flat like if they were in the same room. And the toilet were very noisy the pump. nice decoration but if it is impossible to sleep it doesnt worth it!!

title: London in another way!
text: The hotel location is super! The hotel staff ia very nice and helpful. There is a luggage room for free! There is the USB charger for mobile phones in the room and you don't Need the adaptor. Breakfast is 3.50 pounds and you can choose bread, jam, butter, coffee, juice, tra, yougurt. Nothing really special, but the price is low, so it's ok. There is the bathroom in the room, very small and an hairdryer. The price ia too expensive for the hotel rooms. Very very small and not so comfortable for the price you pay. On the other hand, the hotel is 5 minutes walking from King's Cross station, so Easy to go everywhere. A special Word for the staff at the reception, very kind very helpful, very nice!!!

title: You get what you pay for
text: The staff on reception were extremely helpful and friendly. The apartment was a fair size and had the basic amenities included (microwave etc.). Location was perfect for Hyde Park and Paddington Station. The flight of stairs was long, with no elevator/lift facility. There were a few cracks in the walls and windows on the stairways too. Our apartment had a strange smell coming from the sink whenever it was turned on too.

title: Sad disapointment
text: I stayed recently in what I thought was a REALLY nice room.. service was excelent.. UNTIL it was time to sleep. There is a partially frosted glass wall which connects the bathroom to the rest of the room and is right next to the bed. It is simply not enough to protect from light pouring out of the bathroom and straight on the bed.. which wakes up the occupant every time the light is turned on.

title: The cold shoulder..............
text: I booked this hotel via Hotwire and got a great price, i think it was circa £80 for the night. From a location point of view its not great. Its on the wrong side of the river for most tourist's. the nearest tube station is Vauxhall but i wouldn't want to make that walk too late at night or allow my wife to walk it late on her own. The hotel is very stylish with a great bar and the rooms are well appointed albeit slightly too close to the main railway line to Waterloo, but not too much noise. I had a major issue with my rooms air-conditioing in that it remained on all night at its lowest temperature, my stay was in December and it would have been warmer outside. I had to sleep with my head under the duvet, the shower was bliss but i hurriedly got dressed. My feet were still numb with cold as a stood at reception and asked, well demanded that they visit the room to validate my story......they didn't. If i was at a premier inn i would have received a refund, all i got was the offer of an coffee! I was told that the next time i booked i would be well looked after, had the email of the duty manager and we kept in touch. I emailed to book another room and bearing in mind i paid £80 last time.......£256!!!!! In summary not a great location, a good hotel with 1970's style customer service. If you get it at a great price go for it, if not then keep on looking.

title: No one was at the front desk! No service, surprisingly bad service apartment. 最悪のサービスと呑気なカスタマーサポート。
text: Go Nativeのチェーン。立地は良いが、オフィス街なので日曜日夜は周辺のレストランも店も開いていないので要注意。 １ベッドルームの部屋は、こじんまりとしているが快適。キッチンには食器や紅茶も揃っており調理はしやすい。洗濯乾燥機も便利。シーツは変えてくれないし、清掃も無し。自分でゴミ出しの必要もある。 問題は基本的な対応。午後８時半までしかフロントに人がいないということで、７時半に到着。 数人のゲストがフロントの前にたむろしていたが、従業員の姿は皆無。そのうち皆さん諦めて誰もいなくなった。が、さて困った。カスタマーサポートに電話してみたら、部屋のカギを用意してあるはずだから事務所に入って金庫を開けろという。フロントの人間は不在だが飲みかけのコーヒーに、点けっぱなしのラジオがデスクの上に放置。嫌な気持ちで暗証番号を聞いて開けてみたが中は空っぽ。サポートの外国人風のオバサンとああでもない、こうでもないと３０分以上電話で話しながら事務所の中を探す。 そのうちファックス・マシーンの裏側に封筒が二つ落ちているのを見つける。ひとつに自分の名前を発見！ 中にカギも入っている。ポーランド系と思しきカスタマーセンターのオバサンは、Good job!と電話の向こうで笑っている。どっと疲れる体験だった。余談だが、ロストバゲッジのスーツケースが真夜中の二時半に届いた。 フロントには誰もいないので携帯電話に連絡があり、建物の入り口を開けろと言う。 延着したスーツケースは破損で真っ二つに割れていた。英国のサービスは落ちるとこまで落ちたのか。

title: Meh...
text: The hotels pictures are misleading. The room it a lot smaller than their strategic photography! The TV didn’t work and the curtain was falling down. The one pillow might as well have not even been there and the bed is very small. At breakfast you get a different menu to the public that doesn’t have as much choice. The woman taking our order didn’t speak very good English and I ended up with a weird spinach smoothie when I asked for some apple juice which I was charged extra for!!

title: Not the best
text: When checking in, the guy on reception was extremely helpful, and a lovely guy to chat to too! The room itself was the only downside to this hotel! Looking past the dated decor, it still needs a makeover! Parts of the carpet are worn down, head board falling off (wouldn’t like to think why), lack of black out curtains waking me up at an ungodly hour! Upon closer inspection, I found around the skirting boards hadn’t been cleaned thoroughly in quite some time, leaving a build up of dust... and a previous guests finger nail clipping! This hotel is in fantastic location for Wembley Stadium, however is on a busy road, with lots of traffic, causing noise through the night (which is of course no ones fault). Me and my sister in law came to see Taylor Swift, and found it was a 10 minuet walk to Kilburn Station, 4 stops, then you’re at Wembley Park Station, where you have a further 5 minuets walk to the stadium! There is a small, very tight car park at the back of the hotel, costing £10 per night, which you almost don’t have much choice other than to use it, as there are no other car parks around, and on street parking is Permit Holders only, or Pay and Display. The one star is only for the guy on reception and the location. Would only stay again if I seen they’d updated their hotel
